paraphrase: Open premise, the fuller nominal profile under the adopted component-remoteness reading: the name 'God' applies in its proper sense to the only being maximal in being (above all), causing the being and every perfection of every other being (principle/cause of all), and entering into the composition of nothing (remote from all). This retains the encoded source conditions under that stated reading and is formally weaker than STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-UNIQUE-MAXIME-ENS. It neither identifies component exclusion with genus transcendence nor claims to exhaust every interpretation of q.13 a.8 ad 2.
